narrative.overview:
The approved world uses Halyard Display Variable, warm off-white, charcoal, cobalt, generous gutters, thin dividers, and the original AS mark. Large names and role text carry the hierarchy. The real portrait supplies the photographic material.

This record extracts the current five-section homepage foundation from app/globals.css and app/page.tsx. It covers ticket 01, not a complete release. Halyard delivery is missing and the current preview renders a neutral fallback. The approved composition image is unavailable, so this document does not establish an approved pixel match. PRODUCT.md records durable commitments; .impeccable/surfaces/app-page-tsx.md owns this homepage's composition, and docs/assets.md records asset provenance and missing inputs.
keyCharacteristics: Warm off-white and charcoal with one cobalt accent.
Large, tightly spaced typography and generous section spacing.
Rectangular photography, thin dividers, and small cobalt corners.
Native anchor navigation in the current development preview.

rules.name: The Accent Rule
rules.body: Use cobalt for the established identity details and contact field; preserve the original AS mark's supplied blue shading.

rules.name: The Font Delivery Rule
rules.body: Preserve Halyard as the required family and recheck wrapping, spacing, and hierarchy when its authorized web delivery is available.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Preserve the current flat treatment when extending this homepage.

dos: Do preserve the exact Design • Engineer identity phrase.
Do retain the supplied AS mark and real portrait with their documented provenance.
Do keep visible keyboard focus and native anchor access.
Do recheck the design after Halyard is delivered.
donts: Don't promote the current neutral fallback to approved typography.
Don't describe static project rows or pending contact details as completed interactions.
Don't claim a pixel match to the missing composition image or a complete release.
